commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Reims failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+5' St Etienne failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+3' The referee allows time for a substitution. Louis Mouton will be replaced by Florian Tardieu (St Etienne).
90+3' Eirik Horneland has decided to make a change. Djyilian N'Guessan (St Etienne) replaces Lucas Stassin.
90+2' Yellow card. Leo Petrot (St Etienne) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Aimen Moueffek (St Etienne) is penalised for a foul. Stephanie Frappart had a clear view and blows his whistle.
88' Junya Ito (Reims) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
85' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Reims comes to nothing.
83' 14:9 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
81' Here's the change. Keito Nakamura (Reims) leaves the pitch and Mamadou Diakhon comes on as a substitute.
81' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Sergio Akieme (Reims) as he is replaced by Nhoa Sangui.
81' Joseph Okumu joins the action as a substitute, replacing Thibault De Smet (Reims).
80' 3 - 1 Goal! Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) skips past challenges and from close range brilliantly chips the ball over Yehvann Diouf. 3:1. Wonderful individual effort.
78' Reims failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

76' Sergio Akieme (Reims) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball goes out of play and St Etienne will have a goal kick.
74' Eirik Horneland prepares a substitution. Mathieu Cafaro is replaced by Aimen Moueffek (St Etienne).
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Igor Miladinovic (St Etienne) comes onto the pitch so that Augustine Boakye can be given a rest.
73' Stephanie Frappart shows a yellow card to Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) for his blatant foul.
72' Keito Nakamura (Reims) sends a chip pass into the box, but Gautier Larsonneur is quickest to intercept the ball.
70' Teddy Teuma (Reims) has a go from distance but he can't find the target as it goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and St Etienne will have a goal kick.
66' Buta (Reims) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Stephanie Frappart had an easy-decision to make.
65' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from St Etienne comes to nothing.
65' Here is a change. Amadou Kone is going off and Luka Elsner gives the last tactical orders to Teddy Teuma (Reims).
64' Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee signals a corner kick to St Etienne.
61' Substitution. Oumar Diakite makes way for Amine Salama (Reims).

57' 2 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Lucas Stassin, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Augustine Boakye (St Etienne), who beats Yehvann Diouf with a brilliant shot into the top right corner. 2:1.
56' The corner is swung in but St Etienne can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
53' St Etienne have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

50' 1 - 1 Mickael Nade produces a sweet pass and picks out Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the middle of the net and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 1:1!
47' An attempted cross from Junya Ito (Reims) is cleared.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' The resulting set piece from Reims is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
42' 0 - 1 What an excellent finish! Keito Nakamura (Reims) latched on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and slotted the ball ino the middle of the net. Unstoppable shot!
41' A pass from Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) is intercepted by Yehvann Diouf and the move breaks down.
37' St Etienne take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
35' Reims quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
33' Junya Ito (Reims) swings in a cross from the corner, but Gautier Larsonneur reads it well and gathers the ball.
32' Louis Mouton (St Etienne) shows off his amazing technique to get in front of goal by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the right post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
29' St Etienne failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
27' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Dennis Appiah (St Etienne) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
25' The percentage of ball possession is – 67:33.
23' Louis Mouton (St Etienne) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for St Etienne.
21' Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
20' Reims can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
19' Keito Nakamura (Reims) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Reims win a corner.
17' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Reims.
14' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St Etienne.
11' St Etienne are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
8' Louis Mouton (St Etienne) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
7' Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
5' Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.

2' Leo Petrot (St Etienne) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
2' Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) takes the corner.
